texts: How we rig a 3D garment: put it on a body, rig the pair, then take the body away

A shirt has no skeleton, so our garment forge rigs each piece while a reference body is wearing it, then removes the body and keeps the weights the cloth picked up from the joints underneath. The write-up follows one real shirt through the seven stages and the gates a piece passes before it is published: three.ws/wardrobe

issues.quote: How we rig a 3D garment: put it on a body, rig the pair, then take the body away
issues.problem: The house standard for an Article is a title of 80 to 100 characters carrying the headline number. This title carries no number, while the article has strong verified ones (seven stages, 52 joints, 40,000 triangles, 2.87 cm mean deviation).
issues.fix: Retitle, e.g. "How we rig a 3D garment: seven stages, a 52-joint reference body, and 2.87 cm of cloth stray" (90 characters; every number verified).

issues.quote: | Slot | Box centre (m) | Box size (m) | Fit |
issues.problem: The eight rows of numeric box centres and sizes in the slot table are presented as fact, but the passing evidence only supports that each slot has a measured box and that the hair envelope is 0.80 m tall and crown-anchored. None of the quoted verification covers the per-slot centre/size values, so they cannot be checked from the evidence given.
issues.fix: Add an evidence check quoting the SLOT_BOXES values from workers/garment-forge/garment_glb.py for every row, or trim the table to only what a passing check verifies.

issues.problem: The trimmed manifest asserts specific occludes regions for the oxford shirt, but no passing verification quotes the occludes field of the manifest. The claim that the manifest pins checksum, licence and skeleton is verified; the occlusion list is not.
issues.fix: Add an evidence check quoting the occludes array from the live manifest at https://storage.googleapis.com/three-ws-garments/garments/top/a-white-oxford-cotton-dress-cf4ea6/v1/manifest.json, or cut that line from the trimmed JSON.

issues.problem: The cover supports the post (three real catalog garments in live viewers) and the alt text matches the image exactly. The three additional inline images referenced in the body (photo-to-shirt.png, rig-doctor-shirt.png, catalog-grid.png) are not included in what I can inspect, so only their alt text can be judged, which is accurate and specific. Confirm the Rig Doctor frame shows all four limb groups marked Will animate before shipping, since that caption carries a claim.
issues.fix: Recapture rig-doctor-shirt.png live on three.ws/rig-doctor loading the oxford shirt GLB so every limb group showing Will animate is visible in the frame.

editor.summary: A strong, well-sourced Article: the lead post is compliant, the structure hits every house requirement, and nearly every claim is verified against files and live pages. Two unverified details (the slot-box measurement table and the manifest's occludes list) and a title without the headline number must be fixed before shipping.
